messages:
jamal: CI perf alarm: staging release/1.12 perf-suite failed on kv-heavy benchmark, p50 +28%, p95 +45%. tagging @maria @alex
ci-bot: Perf CI report: build 3124
metric: latency.p50 38ms -> 49ms (+28%)
kv_cache.hit_rate 0.62 -> 0.37 (-40%)
report: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/3124
alex: ugh. did we merge a batching heuristic or prefetch change yesterday?
maria: yes, merged PR #8421 from @lucy — changed seqlen batching switch and made kv-prefetch more aggressive. i'm running a quick local repro now.
tara: i can kick off a bisect across staging builds 3100..3124, want me to start?
jamal: please do. start with git bisect between 3109 (good) and 3124 (bad). suspect commits: 9f1c7d9 (batching) or 6b2e3a4 (kv prefetch).
tara: bisect started, running perf harness against small-chat workload (concurrency 16, seqlen dist small). will post interim numbers.
tara: bisect result: culprit identified as 6b2e3a4 — kv prefetch backoff removed. reproduces locally with same perf regression (kv hit rate drops).
maria: ACK. options: full revert on main, or hotfix cherry-pick to release/1.12 and patch main separately. prefer minimal blast radius -> backport cherry-pick to release branch then fix main.
alex: agreed. i'll prepare a hotfix branch and run integration perf tests. patch branch name: hotfix/kv-prefetch-backoff
commands to validate locally:
```
git checkout -b hotfix/kv-prefetch-backoff
git cherry-pick 6b2e3a4
make integration-test && ./tools/run-perf --bench kv-small-chat --runs 5
```
jamal: QA plan: canary on two dedicated hosts in us-west-2, watch kv_hit_rate, p50, error-rate. notify on regressions.
release-bot: Backport PR opened: #8428 -> release/1.12 by maria. CI status: unit tests passed, integration/perf running.
tara: canary integration perf (after cherry-pick): p50 39ms -> 36ms, kv_cache.hit_rate 0.63 -> 0.61 (near baseline). starting rollout to 20% traffic.
maria: merging backport after green. will also file follow-up PR to reintroduce prefetch but with conservative backoff. thanks all :tada:
jamal: monitoring rollout in console, will abort and revert if any spike. closing thread once 24h stable.
